meta.title: Vietnam Vlog EP-04 | Venice in Vietnam | Indian Married Couple | Grand World Phu Quoc, Water Taxi 🇻🇳
meta.description:
Welcome to Episode 4 of our magical Vietnam Travel Series! 💑✨
We’re a 28-year-old Indian married couple, discovering Vietnam one adventure at a time — and today, we explore the dreamy, colorful, and lively streets of Grand World Phu Quoc! 🇻🇳🌈

Nicknamed the “City That Never Sleeps,” Grand World is Vietnam’s version of a European wonderland, filled with lights, canals, night markets, cultural shows, and so much beauty.

And yes — we even took a romantic Venice-style Water Taxi ride through its beautiful canal 😍🚤

📍 What’s in This Episode:
🏰 Grand World Phu Quoc
We explored this vibrant cultural and entertainment district where you’ll find:

🛍️ Charming European-style streets and buildings
🛶 Water Taxi Ride – One of our favorite moments! A peaceful and scenic canal ride just like Venice, but in Vietnam!
🥢 Local food stalls and souvenir markets to enjoy authentic Vietnamese vibes

Whether you're a couple, family, or solo traveler — Grand World has something for everyone. It’s FREE to enter and perfect for relaxing walks, Instagram-worthy photos, and romantic vibes 🌙✨

🌍 About Our Channel:
We’re Simran & Vaibhav , a young Indian married couple, sharing our real-life journey of:

❤️ Love, partnership & married life
✈️ Raw & unfiltered travel stories
🎥 Honest couple moments, silly desi struggles, and emotional highs
📌 Real couple goals — no filters, just love & laughter
We’re here to inspire other Indian couples to explore the world, dream big, and enjoy every moment together 💕

👉 If you love lights, culture, colors, and chill romantic vibes, this episode is for you!
🎥 Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE to join our journey — and tell us who you'd love to ride the Water Taxi with! 💦🛶

🎒 Stay tuned for upcoming episodes and our full Vietnam couple itinerary!
